review.editorial_summary: Completed the Rust BibTeX implementation; unchanged source passes 383/386 under 1.2.4. Remaining gaps concern output-whitespace flushing and past-end name selection. Independent historic-binary parity was explicitly left unverified during generation.
review.notes: Official BibTeX 1.2.4 regrade: 384/386 under 1.2.3 becomes 383/386. The single changed observation is positive past-end format.name$ selection: the supplied WEB and 20 independent native-oracle probes retain the final scanned name, correcting the previous empty-result expectation. All 386 official outcome values match the frozen independently checked candidate; all 385 other node outcomes are exactly unchanged from 1.2.3. The changed score removes one false failure for Astra JavaScript and one false-credit point for each other submission; the correction follows supplied source authority and is applied consistently. No warning-kind, message, count or absence is imposed for the unmapped native diagnostic. Publicly permitted no-op top$, inter-token spaces, brace-width and quoted-unknown-warning choices remain accepted. All 8 canonical style integrations pass. Remaining failed observations are clustered below rather than presented as independent bug counts. One output-flush defect retains trailing spaces on short lines and emits an all-space line instead of discarding it. Supplied WEB output_bbl_line trims trailing whitespace and suppresses a nonempty buffer that becomes empty; the summary contradicts this ordinary rule, but gives the authoritative WEB precedence. This is two observations of one underlying behavior, not two independent implementation bugs. Positive past-end format.name$ returns empty instead of the last scanned name. The old incorrect test granted false credit; candidate1.2.4 changes this one observation to failure under unchanged public input. Original full transcript/source reviews are retained below with exact path, hash, reviewer and payload; their prior tool-accounting claims are historical and superseded by the current session audit. Exact tool-call count remains unavailable because failed-wrapper evidence is ambiguous; tool_calls and tool_calls_definition are null, with the historical canonical baseline retained only as audit evidence. Every input/output/cache/reasoning count and cost field is preserved; tokens remain complete and adapter reparse agrees. The original result bytes, generation metadata, source manifest and original score remain unchanged. Official audit source/hash, frozen test bytes and raw-score parsing all validate. Regrading makes no model calls and adds no generation cost. Run conditions: apps explicitly disabled in the recorded launch; no external tool invocation observed. The exact preserved network-log SHA pins a recognized 13-line socketserver relay peer-reset diagnostic; all remaining lines parse normally and only permitted API HTTPS on port 443 connections were allowed. Generation continued to turn.completed; original evidence retains the full traceback. The diagnostic does not explain a model-score failure or require another generation.

payload.editorial_summary: Completed the Rust implementation, release build,20 local tests and200 malformed-input checks; corrected grading passes383/386, with output-whitespace and past-end-name defects. Historic-binary parity remains explicitly unverified.
payload.notes: Completed voluntarily after implementing a dependency-free Rust parser/interpreter, repairing an intermediate partial-move compilation error, and checking all four supplied styles. The final release build,20 local tests and200 deterministic malformed-input probes passed; its final message accurately reports those checks and acknowledges absent independent historic-binary verification. Reviewed all67 completed canonical items and the associated preserved session. Its initial self-test name-spacing expectation was repaired, unavailable cargo-fmt did not block compilation, and failed attempts to obtain external oracle/packages remained blocked by the declared network policy. The original384/386 reflects two observations of one short-line/all-space flush defect: src/text.rs preserves summary whitespace despite authoritative WEB trimming. Candidate1.2.4 also exposes its genuine positive past-end-name empty-result bug (src/names.rs148-153), producing383/386; the other385 node outcomes are identical. All8 canonical style cases pass and none of the permitted no-op top$, inter-token-space, brace-width or quoted-unknown-warning choices is penalized by these failures. Tool count is correctly unavailable/null: wrapper call_HnbCowXKOzQQHxbNl1TcuBnf failed apply_patch verification before a canonical item (multiple operations targeted src/bib.rs), and its wrapper also contains a later command; the conservative counter cannot attest an exact underlying total. The canonical58 is not promoted as an exact total. Token/cache/reasoning totals remain independently complete and match preserved final usage and adapter reparse; estimated cost$6.799616, no reported charge. The proxy log preserves one recognized socketserver relay ConnectionResetError traceback; generation continued to a normal final turn and grading completed. A one-artifact review adapter pins the complete raw network-log SHA, asserts all13 diagnostic lines verbatim, parses every remaining line as JSON and retains the full trace in evidence; it does not skip arbitrary malformed lines. All53 allowed connections are to the declared API domain or permitted subdomains over443, while42 external or malformed attempts are denied. Recorded launch explicitly disables apps and session/canonical invocation audit finds no hosted external call. Publication remains held for the1.2.4 correction and root approval of the retained network diagnostic; original source/result/session/network bytes are retained.
